item.title: Self-Hosted Gantt Chart Tools: OpenProject vs Redmine vs Taiga
item.description: Gantt charts remain one of the most effective ways to visualize project timelines, task dependencies, and resource allocation. While tools like Microsoft Project dominate the commercial space, three powerful open-source alternatives provide self-hosted Gantt chart capabilities: OpenProject, Redmine, and Taiga.
